title: Doc-as-code gate (validate-agents-md) + check-count assertions + golden-fixtures for CAM_*_STATUS
description: Three parse/doc-safety items mapping to cam's own recurring lessons. (1) Doc-as-code gate (check:agents / validate-agents-md.ts): assert every 'cam <cmd>' / 'bun run <x>' and every backtick path cited in CLAUDE.md, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, and .claude/agents/* resolves to a real script/path, with a known-missing allowlist. Mechanically enforces the 2026-06-05 stale-comment lesson and the Doc-Maintenance rule. (2) check-count assertions: freeze the count of gates/oracles/health-checks so one silently disappearing fails a test, not just stays green (seeds doctor pass===12 pattern). (3) Golden-fixtures for the CAM_*_STATUS sentinel + handoff.json parsing: capture real worker-CLI output as test/.../__golden__/*.jsonl + a canonical form and diff in tests, so a silent upstream claude wire-shape change fails a test. Direct antidote to the recurring supervisor-sentinel-parse-fragility class (CAM-32/35). Source: seeds validate-agents-md.ts + doctor.test.ts; burrow src/runtime/parsers/__golden__/.
